messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Gladstone Arms?
messages.body:
Hi Natalie,

Thanks for getting in touch, hope you're well. Jake sounds good but it's not quite right for The Glad. I book every Sun/Tue there an focus on emerging artists, solo and duos, playing originals. I'll let you know if ever working on anything suitable though.

Best,
Sam
